label: Source truth survives while four distinct record application conditions fail
paraphrase: Four explicit same-carrier controls retain the informed genuinely asserting truthful source. First, planned false signs are effectively produced and transmitted but the plans are not assertions. Second, true assertoric plans fail to describe the actually caused false tokens. Third, true coded tokens are actually received through a corrupting channel that violates RECORD_TRANSPORT_2. Fourth, a correctly decoded false token comes from another source while the proposed truthful source still causes its correct token. Each corresponding record family is unsound; the other displayed bundle conditions hold. These are omissions in the selected structural interpretation, not evidence that a perfect source actually deceives or that global fabrication is metaphysically possible.
